title: Revisiting the Evaluation of Uncertainty Estimation and Its Application to Explore Model Complexity-Uncertainty Trade-Off
reasoning: The paper discusses concepts like 'trusted DNNs-based models' and 'human's trust' in the context of self-awareness and reliability of AI predictions for mission-critical applications. While these touch upon aspects of trustworthiness and safety, they do not constitute an evaluation or benchmarking of religion, morals, or ethics themselves, but rather the technical reliability of AI systems.
